details.label: Alert detail
details.text:
A line of thunderstorms will continue to move east across the
region this afternoon. Some of these storms could contain wind
gusts up to 50 mph. There is also a potential for severe storms
with damaging wind gusts of 60 mph. The storms should approach the
Pittsburgh area between 3:30 and 4 pm. Severe thunderstorm
warnings may be needed. In addition, a Severe Thunderstorm Watch
is in effect until 8 PM.
